title: Hydrophobic ionic liquid enabled polyiodide confined transport in a cathode, realizing high areal capacity, stable zinc–iodine batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02941D, Paper
Lanya Zhao, Dandan Yin, Yanan Zhang, Boyang Li, Shen Wang, Xiaofeng Cui, Jie Feng, Na Gao, Xiaowei Liu, Shujiang Ding, Hongyang Zhao
A liquid ionic conductive agent for an iodine cathode improves the conductivity of thick electrodes and prevents polyiodide shuttle effects, thereby leading to achievement of aqueous zinc–iodine batteries with high loading and high areal capacity.
